Donald tells her he finds the work repetitive and is “not as into it,” so she learns that much, but not the deeper reason.
- In Scenario 2, Gloria still does not know whether Donald’s job dissatisfaction is truly caused by larger personal issues. She merely suspects this after reflecting. She then chooses to offer support or advice by suggesting he consider talking to a professional. She does not know whether this advice will help or how Donald will fully react internally.
- Later events, such as Donald’s eventual renewed enthusiasm or his appreciation, are not known to Gloria at the time of Scenarios 1–2 and do not affect her intention change between those two scenarios.

So Gloria’s intention does change: in Scenario 1, it is to find out if Donald is truly unhappy; in Scenario 2, it is to offer support or advice.
